description: Billiard simulation for sequencing: balls bounce around a table, and their positions and collisions come out as polyphonic voltages

params.text: Sets how many balls are in play, 1 to 16; changing it starts the scene again
The coefficient of restitution, 0 to 2; at 1 collisions lose no speed and above 1 the balls speed up with every collision
Sets the radius of every ball while the R input is unpatched, 0.05 to 0.15 of the table

inputs.text: With a cable patched here, triggers are held back until the next rising edge instead of firing the moment a ball hits something
A rising edge starts the scene again, giving every ball a new position and velocity
Sets the seed the random generator takes when the scene starts again, so the same scene comes back; the seed is the voltage divided by ten
Sets the starting X position of each ball, one channel per ball, 0-10V across the width of the table
Sets the starting Y position of each ball, one channel per ball, 0-10V across the height of the table
Sets the starting X velocity of each ball, one channel per ball, 0-10V spanning full speed left to full speed right
Sets the starting Y velocity of each ball, one channel per ball, 0-10V spanning full speed up to full speed down
Sets the radius of each ball separately, one channel per ball, -5V to 5V spanning 0.05 to 0.15 of the table

outputs.text: A 1ms trigger on a ball's channel when that ball hits a wall
A 1ms trigger on a ball's channel when that ball collides with another; both balls fire
The X position of each ball, one channel per ball, -5V to 5V across the table
The Y position of each ball, one channel per ball, -5V to 5V across the table
